description: This file contains CUDA device functions, templates, and macros for symmetric memory operations, including atomic compare-and-swap, signal handling, synchronization patterns, and vectorized memory load/store for CUDA and ROCm architectures.
published: specialized structs and functions for vectorized memory operations

classes.name: MultimemLdReduce
classes.description: Template struct for performing vectorized load and reduction operations on memory, specialized for different data types.

methods.name: cas
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap operation on a 32-bit integer at a given address, with support for CUDA and ROCm architectures.

methods.name: trap
methods.description: Triggers a trap or aborts execution depending on the architecture, used for error handling.

methods.name: global_timer_ns
methods.description: Returns a high-resolution global timer value in nanoseconds, architecture-dependent.

methods.name: try_put_signal
methods.description: Attempts to set a signal at a memory address within a timeout period, using atomic operations.

methods.name: try_wait_signal
methods.description: Waits for a signal to be set at a memory address within a timeout period.

methods.name: put_signal
methods.description: Sets a signal at a memory address atomically.

methods.name: wait_signal
methods.description: Waits for a signal to be cleared at a memory address atomically.

methods.name: sync_remote_blocks
methods.description: Synchronizes blocks across devices using signals, supporting different memory access patterns.

methods.name: multimem_ld_reduce_add
methods.description: Performs vectorized load and reduction with a specified alignment and data type.

methods.name: multimem_st
methods.description: Stores a vectorized memory value to a specified memory address, architecture-dependent.

methods.name: add_bf16x2
methods.description: Adds two bfloat16 vectors, supporting CUDA and ROCm architectures.

methods.name: add_vec
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two vectorized memory objects for different data types.

methods.name: load_and_reduce
methods.description: Loads and reduces memory from multiple pointers, specialized for balanced and unbalanced cases.
